Perfect for a quiet weekend get away, a group tennis weekend or a family friendly beach vacation, this gorgeous 4 bedroom, 4 bath Tuscan designed villa is located in "Villa Lago” on the golf course within the Sandestin Golf and Beach Resort. A unique and welcoming community nestled between the fairways of the Baytowne Golf Course, Villa Lago offers our guests the privacy and amenities of a luxury hotel and a cruise ship plus access to all of the fun and excitement of the Sandestin Golf and Beach Resort has to offer! Spanning more than 2400 acres, Sandestin has something for everyone. Family friendly Village of Baytown Wharf, 4 championship golf courses, the Sandestin Academy, 1 98 slip marina, various watersports, world class tennis courts, 45+ retail shops/boutiques, 25+ restaurants including waterfront dining and live music, salon and day spa, dine in movie theatre, outdoor sports and more!!

"Tuscan Tides" is not managed by a rental company, so you are our #1 priority! We are excited to provide you with tips, recommendations, and information to make your stay one you will never forget.

Tuscan Tides at Villa Lago Amenities:

-Located just steps from the community pool, this charming up-to-date Tuscan style home is prepared with your comfort and stay in mind! We have filled the villa with our favorite " vacation things" , leaving nothing out. We hope that you will agree, "Tuscan Tides"... is the perfect place for you to call "home"!

-Pack less and play more with our fully stocked beach garage. We have toys, boogie boards, beach toys, noodles, balls, beach chairs, beach umbrella, and more already provided for you!

- Two electric golf carts for your use around Sandestin Resort! Do some guests want to head to the beach while others want to play tennis? No worries! Having two golf carts means you can keep everyone happy and the car in the driveway. New 6 seater with radio and back up camera and a 4 seater.

- Modern and furnished kitchen with oven, electric cooktop, fridge/freezer, wine fridge, dishwasher and plenty of cooking tools. You'll have everything needed for making sandwiches for the beach, or a night at home cooking dinner(including crockpot)We have a brew coffee pot and a Keurig for making the perfect cup of Joe to start your day!

-Open and spacious living area provides a comfortable space for the whole family to gather, play games, watch movies and dine! Step out onto the back porch to grill or take inn the gorgeous gold course views. Large HDTV is equipped with Netflix and Google Chromecast for streaming your favorite movies from any app on your phone.


-Bedroom Breakdown
Room #1- Located downstairs, prefect for early risers or guests who prefer not to use the stairs everyday. This room is equipped with a Queen bed, Smart TV, and uses the downstairs spa bath with pebble floored, glass enclosed shower.

--Room #2- Second Floor Suite with two twin beds than can be pushed together as one bed, en-suite bath with pebble floored, glass enclosed shower, HDTV with Google Chromecast form streaming and closet.

--Room #3- second Floor Bunk Room! The kids or kids at heart) will love this room. Features two bunk beds: one standard twin and one Full/twin combo. Huge closet for storing luggage. En-Suite bathroom with large tub. HDTV with Google Chromecast for streaming and Blue-ray player.

--Room #4- The King Master Suite. Huge room with private balcony surrounded by palm trees. Enjoy the large spa bath with Jacuzzi tub, Mr. Steam pebbled floored shower and two shower heads, double vanities, and a relaxing spa color palate. Relax in the evenings and take in a movie in bed on the HDTV with Google Chromecast for streaming Netflix, HULU and You Tube!!

Beach Access:

The beach access for Tuscan TIdes is the Sandestin Beach Access located at the Beach House Restaurant 2 miles inside the gates of resort from the home. You will find the easy access to Baytown Wharf entertainment, dining and shoping far outweight the cart drive to the beach. Take a cart or your personal car!

Pool Access:

Homes within the Villa Lago Community have access to four pools in the Sandestin Resort. One of the pools is located just steps away from the home , so no need to load everyone in the car! The other pools are : SOA Pool 1, SOA Pool #2, and our personal favorite, the NEW Phil Hummel Aquatic Center.

THE SANDESTIN GOLF AND BEACH RESORT

Centrally located, Villa Lago is an easy walk or golf cart ride to virtually everything the Sandestin Golf and Beach Resort has to offer:
- Spectacular Emerald Coast Beach with dining, watersports, chair/umbrella set up, lifeguards, sundries and restroom facilities.
-4 Championship Golf courses
-The Sandestin Golf Academy
-Award winning Tennis center with 15 lit, clay courts
-98 slip marina with boating and fishing charters available
-Fishing in 72 stocked lakes
-Day Spa and Salon
-Adult and children sport, educational and entertainment programs.
-Sandestin's Baytown Wharf: offering an array of shopping, dining, and entertainment options, including dancing & live music, outdoor concerts, zip lining, the tower climb, 18 hole putt-putt course and the childrens activities.
-The Grand Boulevard at Sandestin featuring boutique shopping at retailers like Pottery Barn, Tommy Bahama and Williams Sonoma. Local eateries like Vintage and Craft Burgers and fine dining like Flemings and PF Changs. Have a rainy afternoon? No problem, spend the afternon at the BLVD 10 Cinema Theatre snacking on popcorn and watching the newest movie releases! You can even take the cart to Starbucks and Pubix!
-Need gym Access? Grand Fitness at Grand Boulevard offers day passes & week long passes and is just a gold cart ride away. some guests even walk/run/jog there. *Things to do- Sandestin Marina Flats and Bay Fishing/ call Capt Pat. 850-685-3074… or Lil Lucky fishing charters 850-699-2286


Cleaning Practices (Best Cleaner in the industry…we get what we pay for)

-Cleaned with disinfectant
-Check in and check out with no person-to-person contact
-All towels and bedding washed in hot water that's at least 60 degrees C/140 degrees F
-High-touch surfaces cleaned with disinfectant (like countertops, light switches, handles and faucets)

We look forward to welcoming you and your guests to "Tuscan Tides." Please feel free to reach out to me with any questions, concerns or for more information about our home or the resort!

However, Owners/Agent agree to do all that is humanly possible to remedy any issue as quickly as possible.
